_comment: Pay-per-use template: each call is paid individually, no account. Suited to low-frequency / high-value calls (AI inference, report generation, data queries).
_comment_facilitator: Default: platform facilitator (settler maintained by the platform, no local gas). Self-hosted is opt-in: set http://127.0.0.1:8410 and run skills/x402/facilitator/server.py with a funded settler.
